name: Example: antiparasitic selectivity screen
title: Reference screen -- published antiparasitic naphthoquinones against trypanosomatid enzymes and their human counterparts
description: EXAMPLE campaign, shipped with the platform. It uses only public PDB targets and published reference compounds, so the repository is runnable without any research data. It demonstrates the platform's central pattern: each parasite enzyme is docked alongside its human counterpart, and selectivity is read from the difference.

paths._note: No data_root declared, deliberately: the root comes from $DOCKING_DATA_DIR. Results do not live in the repository.
